spoken: Moon gone. Gravity lingers. Lunar tides start changing next. Known physics says the mechanism is orbital angular momentum, tidal forcing and the Earth–Moon barycenter. The best supported consequence is this: ocean tides, axial stability and nights would change on different timescales. The exact timeline depends on how the impossible change occurs.
